metadata.title: अबूझमाड़ में माओवादियों को तगड़ा झटका | Maoist Movement: Beginning of the End | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
In a major anti-Maoist operation in Chhattisgarh’s Abujhmad, 27 Naxals, including top CPI (Maoist) leader Basavaraju, were killed. Two DRG jawans, Ramesh Hemla and Khotulram Korram, were also martyred. The joint operation by DRG teams from four districts dealt a significant blow to Maoist presence in the Maad region.

#AbujhmadEncounter #BasavarajuKilled #DRG #MaoistNews #Chhattisgarh
